2026-07-23 02:14:12.666412 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-07-23 02:14:12.666415 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-07-23 02:14:12.666419 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-07-23 02:14:12.666423 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-07-23 02:14:12.666426 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-07-23 02:14:12.666430 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-07-23 02:14:12.666433 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
2026-07-23 02:14:12.666437 | controller | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
